text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and 
Arima Kinen.

By triumphing in all of them, Satono 
Diamond accomplished the "Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—And... sent. I think that's all of the 
replies taken care of.
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's gonna be quite the grand 
event, huh.

Looks like it's gonna be quite the grand 
event, huh?

text_block_list.text:
It looks like the facilities associated 
with the Satono Group are holding an 
"Autumn Senior Triple Crown Commemorative 
Event" for Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Regarding the commemorative event for 
my Autumn Senior Triple Crown—I replied 
that I would cooperate as much as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like the 'Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown Parfait' will be on the cafe's menu 
starting today. So, I was thinking of 
dropping by to say hello."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you have some time, would you care to 
join us, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, wonderful♪ Well then, let us be on 
our way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Satono-san. I was just on my way to 
see you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san! Did you need me for 
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was hoping to celebrate, but... 
were you busy, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was just on my way to a Satono 
Group cafe...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If you'd like, McQueen-san, would you 
care to go eat the "Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown Parfait" together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A parfait!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a special parfait is being released 
to commemorate my "Senior Fall Triple 
Crown," so I am on my way to the shop for 
a tasting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Limited edition...! I-is that so? Well 
then, since the opportunity presents 
itself, I shall join you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once again... congratulations to you both 
on winning the Senior Autumn Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, won 
by defeating Teio-san, Kita-san, and me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Beyond just Dia-san's personal 
achievements, one could say the Satono 
family has left a glorious mark on the 
Umamusume world as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...You did wonderful out there, Dia-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I might have acted like a senior 
just now, but you and I are on equal 
footing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As rivals, and as Umamusume shouldering 
the honor of our family names. Let us 
sharpen our skills against one another.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I will continue to devote myself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There is still so much I wish to learn 
from you, McQueen-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I also need to go through my own trial and 
error, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I shall firmly engrave into my heart the 
awareness of being a representative of the 
Satono family!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But please feel free to consult me 
whenever you are troubled. We are 
schoolmates, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hawa... McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You truly are wonderful... You will 
forever be the one I look up to...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am honored. However, from now on, 
there will surely be those who look up to 
you as well, Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now it is your turn to be a good senior.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just as McQueen-san once helped me, I 
hope I can be of assistance, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "You will be just fine. Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Everything's going to be fine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much...! Ehehe, I'm so 
happy...♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the parfait is going to melt! Let us 
eat! McQueen-san, please enjoy as much as 
you like.

Those words from Mejiro McQueen seemed to 
be the most wonderful celebration Satono 
Diamond could have ever asked for!
